::: {#def-population-correlation}
#### Population correlation

The **population correlation** of two random variables $X$ and $Y$
with positive variances is

$$\corpar \eqdef \frac{\Cov{X, Y}}{\sqrt{\Var{X} \Var{Y}}},$$

where $\Cov{X, Y}$ is their
[covariance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-cov).
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#rem-sample-correlation-estimates-rho}
#### The sample correlation estimates the population correlation

The [Pearson correlation coefficient](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-pearson-r)
$r$ of a sample is the corresponding sample statistic,
and estimates $\corpar$.
:::
